Class.name: IHC.ITF.Transform.Dtl.AmWellAdtHl7ToCdrPatientMrn
Class.Description: Translates A04s and A03s from AmWell to CDR

XData.name: DTL
XData.Data:
<transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' sourceDocType='AdtAmWellHl7:AmWellAdt' targetDocType='AdtAmWellHl7:AmWellAdt' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>Translates A04 and A03s from AmWell to CDR</annotation> <trace value='"#### DTL:BEGIN ####"' /> <assign value='source.{MSH}' property='target.{MSH}' action='set' /> <assign value='"CDR"' property='target.{MSH:ReceivingApplication.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='"A04"' property='target.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}' action='set' /> <assign value='"AMWELL"' property='target.{MSH:SendingFacility.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='"AMWELL"' property='target.{MSH:SendingApplication.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{EVN}' property='target.{EVN}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:SetIDPID}' property='target.{PID:SetIDPID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientIdentifierList().ID}' property='target.{PID:PatientIdentifierList().ID}' action='set' /> <assign value='$TR(source.{PID:PatientName(1).familyname.surname},".","")' property='target.{PID:PatientName(1).familyname.surname}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientName(1).givenname}' property='target.{PID:PatientName(1).givenname}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientName(1).secondandfurthergivennamesor}' property='target.{PID:PatientName(1).secondandfurthergivennamesor}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:DateTimeOfBirth.timeofanevent}' property='target.{PID:DateTimeOfBirth.timeofanevent}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:AdministrativeSex}' property='target.{PID:AdministrativeSex}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientAddress(1).streetaddressSAD.streetormailingaddress}' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(1).streetaddressSAD.streetormailingaddress}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientAddress(1).otherdesignation}' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(1).otherdesignation}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientAddress(1).city}' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(1).city}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientAddress(1).stateorprovince}' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(1).stateorprovince}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientAddress(1).ziporpostalcode}' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(1).ziporpostalcode}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientAddress(1).country}' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(1).country}' action='set' /> <assign value='"Home Address"' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(1).addresstype}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PhoneNumberHome(1).phonenumber1}' property='srcPhNumber' action='set' /> <if condition='$length(srcPhNumber) > 9' > <true> <assign value='"("_$extract(srcPhNumber,1,3)_")"_$extract(srcPhNumber,4,6)_"-"_$extract(srcPhNumber,7,$length(srcPhNumber))' property='phNumUpdated' action='set' /> <assign value='phNumUpdated' property='target.{PID:PhoneNumberHome(1).phonenumber1}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='source.{PID:PhoneNumberHome(1).Emailaddress}' property='emailAddress' action='set' /> <trace value='"#### DTL:Email Address ####"_emailAddress' /> <trace value='"#### DTL:Email Address Length ####"_$length(emailAddress)' /> <if condition='$length(emailAddress) > 0' > <true> <if condition='$length(emailAddress) > 30' > <true> <if condition='$length(emailAddress) > 60' > <true> <if condition='$length(emailAddress) > 94' > <true> <assign value='$extract(emailAddress,1,30)' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(2).streetaddressSAD.streetormailingaddress}' action='set' /> <assign value='$extract(emailAddress,31,60)' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(2).otherdesignation}' action='set' /> <assign value='$extract(emailAddress,61,94)' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(2).city}' action='set' /> <assign value='$extract(emailAddress,95,100)' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(2).stateorprovince}' action='set' /> </true> <false> <assign value='$extract(emailAddress,1,30)' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(2).streetaddressSAD.streetormailingaddress}' action='set' /> <assign value='$extract(emailAddress,31,60)' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(2).otherdesignation}' action='set' /> <assign value='$extract(emailAddress,61,94)' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(2).city}' action='set' /> </false> </if> </true> <false> <assign value='$extract(emailAddress,1,30)' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(2).streetaddressSAD.streetormailingaddress}' action='set' /> <assign value='$extract(emailAddress,31,60)' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(2).otherdesignation}' action='set' /> </false> </if> </true> <false> <assign value='emailAddress' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(2).streetaddressSAD.streetormailingaddress}' action='set' /> </false> </if> <assign value='"Primary Home Email Address"' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(2).addresstype}' action='set' /> </true> </if>
</transform>
